# justools.in

> justools.in builds small web tools that turn AI instructions and project plans into diagrams people can question and fix. AI suggests changes; the human decides.

## Tools

- [Skill Flow Mapper](https://justools.in/skill-flow): Upload a SKILL.md, Markdown playbook or zipped skill folder. See its workflow as a diagram or mind map, review AI suggestions for gaps, and export PNG, SVG, Mermaid or Markdown. Works with the shared demo or your own Anthropic, OpenAI, Gemini or Mistral key.
- [Project Flow Mapper](https://justools.in/project-flow): Open a project folder or zip to see its architecture, startup paths, routes and call flows. Review AI suggestions for gaps and export the result.
